# A2P SMS Termination Agreement (TST-SMS-2025-001)

Internal ID AGR-TST-SMS-001. Fictional, test use only.
Between **Test Messaging Ltd** ("Supplier") and **Example Exchange** ("Buyer").

<a id="clause-1.1"></a>
1.1 **Parties and term.** Agreement between TST (supplier) and EXX (buyer), effective 2025-03-01, evergreen.

<a id="clause-5.1"></a>
5.1 **Delivery target.** Supplier shall achieve a monthly delivery rate of at least 95.0% per destination network, measured on final delivery receipts received within 72 hours of submission, excluding subscriber errors as listed in Annex B and any period covered by a maintenance notice given at least 48 hours in advance.

<a id="clause-5.2"></a>
5.2 **Response time.** Supplier's NOC shall acknowledge a P1 incident within fifteen (15) minutes and restore service within four (4) hours.

<a id="clause-7.1"></a>
7.1 **Service credit.** If the monthly delivery rate falls below target, Supplier credits 10% of that day's charges.
